versos.hebraico: לֹא־יִקַּ֥ח אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יְגַלֶּ֖ה כְּנַ֥ף אָבִֽיו׃ס

controles.web: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.
controles.kjv: A man shall not take his father’s wife, nor discover his father’s skirt.
controles.livre: Não tomará alguém a mulher de seu pai, nem descobrirá o colo de seu pai.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יָבֹ֧א פְצֽוּעַ־דַּכָּ֛א וּכְר֥וּת שָׁפְכָ֖ה בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
controles.kjv: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord.
controles.livre: Não entrará na congregação do SENHOR o que tiver os testículos esmagados, nem o castrado.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יָבֹ֥א מַמְזֵ֖ר בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא־יָ֥בֹא ל֖וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
controles.kjv: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the Lord.
controles.livre: Não entrará bastardo na congregação do SENHOR: nem ainda na décima geração entrará na congregação do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יָבֹ֧א עַמּוֹנִ֛י וּמוֹאָבִ֖י בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא־יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֛ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever;
controles.kjv: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the Lord for ever:
controles.livre: Não entrará amonita nem moabita na congregação do SENHOR; nem ainda na décima geração entrará na congregação do SENHOR para sempre:

versos.hebraico: עַל־דְּבַ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־קִדְּמ֤וּ אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּלֶּ֣חֶם וּבַמַּ֔יִם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁר֩ שָׂכַ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ אֶת־בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֗וֹר מִפְּת֛וֹר אֲרַ֥ם נַהֲרַ֖יִם לְקַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way, when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
controles.kjv: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.
controles.livre: Porquanto não vos saíram a receber com pão e água ao caminho, quando saístes do Egito; e porque contratou contra ti a Balaão filho de Beor de Petor de Mesopotâmia da Síria, para que te amaldiçoasse.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיַּהֲפֹךְ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֧יךָ לְּךָ֛ אֶת־הַקְּלָלָ֖ה לִבְרָכָ֑ה כִּ֥י אֲהֵֽבְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam; but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless the Lord thy God would not hearken unto Balaam; but the Lord thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee, because the Lord thy God loved thee.
controles.livre: Mas não quis o SENHOR teu Deus ouvir a Balaão; e o SENHOR teu Deus te tornou a maldição em bênção, porque o SENHOR teu Deus te amava.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תִדְרֹ֥שׁ שְׁלֹמָ֖ם וְטֹבָתָ֑ם כָּל־יָמֶ֖יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

controles.web: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.
controles.livre: Não procurarás a paz deles nem seu bem em todos os dias para sempre.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תְתַעֵ֣ב אֲדֹמִ֔י כִּ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ ה֑וּאס לֹא־תְתַעֵ֣ב מִצְרִ֔י כִּי־גֵ֖ר הָיִ֥יתָ בְאַרְצֽוֹ׃

controles.web: You shall not abhor an Edomite; for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.
controles.livre: Não abominarás ao edomita, que teu irmão é: não abominarás ao egípcio, que estrangeiro foste em sua terra.

versos.hebraico: בָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־יִוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם דּ֣וֹר שְׁלִישִׁ֑י יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
controles.kjv: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the Lord in their third generation.
controles.livre: Os filhos que nascerem deles, à terceira geração entrarão na congregação do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מַחֲנֶ֖ה עַל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְנִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ מִכֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֥ר רָֽע׃

controles.web: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
controles.kjv: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.
controles.livre: Quando saíres a campanha contra teus inimigos, guarda-te de toda coisa má.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה טָה֖וֹר מִקְּרֵה־לָ֑יְלָה וְיָצָא֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה לֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;
controles.kjv: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
controles.livre: Quando houver em ti alguém que não for limpo por acidente de noite, sairá do acampamento, e não entrará nele.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֥ה לִפְנֽוֹת־עֶ֖רֶב יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וּכְבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ יָבֹ֖א אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה׃

controles.web: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.
controles.kjv: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.
controles.livre: E será que ao declinar da tarde se lavará com água, e quando for posto o sol, entrará no acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וְיָד֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָצָ֥אתָ שָׁ֖מָּה חֽוּץ׃

controles.web: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
controles.livre: E terás um lugar fora do acampamento, e sairás ali fora;

versos.hebraico: וְיָתֵ֛ד תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ עַל־אֲזֵנֶ֑ךָ וְהָיָה֙ בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֣ ח֔וּץ וְחָפַרְתָּ֣ה בָ֔הּ וְשַׁבְתָּ֖ וְכִסִּ֥יתָ אֶת־צֵאָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
controles.kjv: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:
controles.livre: Terás também uma estaca entre tuas armas; e será que, quando estiveres ali fora, cavarás com ela, e logo ao voltar cobrirás teu excremento:

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ׀ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֗ךָ לְהַצִּֽילְךָ֙ וְלָתֵ֤ת אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה מַחֲנֶ֖יךָ קָד֑וֹשׁ וְלֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת דָּבָ֔ר וְשָׁ֖ב מֵאַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃ס

controles.web: for Yahweh your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
controles.kjv: For the Lord thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus anda por meio de teu acampamento, para livrar-te e entregar teus inimigos diante de ti; portanto será teu acampamento santo: para que ele não veja em ti coisa imunda, e se volte de trás de ti.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תַסְגִּ֥יר עֶ֖בֶד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁר־יִנָּצֵ֥ל אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵעִ֥ם אֲדֹנָֽיו׃

controles.web: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:
controles.livre: Não entregarás a seu senhor o servo que se fugir a ti de seu amo:

versos.hebraico: עִמְּךָ֞ יֵשֵׁ֣ב בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ בַּמָּק֧וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֛ר בְּאַחַ֥ד שְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ בַּטּ֣וֹב ל֑וֹ לֹ֖א תּוֹנֶֽנּוּ׃ס

controles.web: He shall dwell with you, in your midst, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
controles.kjv: He shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.
controles.livre: More contigo, em meio de ti, no lugar que escolher em alguma de tuas cidades, onde bem lhe estiver: não o oprimirás.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה קְדֵשָׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה קָדֵ֖שׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

controles.web: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
controles.kjv: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
controles.livre: Não haverá prostituta das filhas de Israel, nem haverá prostituto ritual dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תָבִיא֩ אֶתְנַ֨ן זוֹנָ֜ה וּמְחִ֣יר כֶּ֗לֶב בֵּ֛ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְכָל־נֶ֑דֶר כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the Lord thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: Não trarás pagamento de prostituta, nem pagamento de prostituto à casa do SENHOR teu Deus por nenhum voto; porque abominação é ao SENHOR teu Deus tanto um como o outro.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תַשִּׁ֣יךְ לְאָחִ֔יךָ נֶ֥שֶׁךְ כֶּ֖סֶף נֶ֣שֶׁךְ אֹ֑כֶל נֶ֕שֶׁךְ כָּל־דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּֽׁךְ׃

controles.web: You shall not lend on interest to your brother; interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:
controles.livre: Não tomarás de teu irmão juros de dinheiro, nem juros de comida, nem juros de coisa alguma que se costuma tomar.

versos.hebraico: לַנָּכְרִ֣י תַשִּׁ֔יךְ וּלְאָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תַשִּׁ֑יךְ לְמַ֨עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֜ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֔ךָ עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: You may lend on interest to a foreigner; but to your brother you shall not lend on interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
controles.kjv: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury: that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
controles.livre: Do estrangeiro tomarás juros, mas de teu irmão não o tomarás, para que te abençoe o SENHOR teu Deus em toda obra de tuas mãos sobre a terra à qual entras para possuí-la.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֨דֶר֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תְאַחֵ֖ר לְשַׁלְּמ֑וֹ כִּֽי־דָּרֹ֨שׁ יִדְרְשֶׁ֜נּוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃

controles.web: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it; for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.
controles.kjv: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the Lord thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the Lord thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.
controles.livre: Quando prometeres voto ao SENHOR teu Deus, não tardarás em pagá-lo; porque certamente o exigirá o SENHOR teu Deus de ti, e haveria em ti pecado.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֥י תֶחְדַּ֖ל לִנְדֹּ֑ר לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃

controles.web: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
controles.kjv: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
controles.livre: Mas quando te abstiveres de prometer, não haverá em ti pecado.

versos.hebraico: מוֹצָ֥א שְׂפָתֶ֖יךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר וְעָשִׂ֑יתָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֜רְתָּ לַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ נְדָבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּפִֽיךָ׃ס

controles.web: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a freewill offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
controles.kjv: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; even a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed unto the Lord thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.
controles.livre: Guardarás o que teus lábios pronunciarem; e farás, como prometeste ao SENHOR teu Deus, o que de tua vontade falaste por tua boca.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י תָבֹא֙ בְּכֶ֣רֶם רֵעֶ֔ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֧ עֲנָבִ֛ים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ֖ שָׂבְעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶֽל־כֶּלְיְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתֵּֽן׃ס

controles.web: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat of grapes your fill at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.
controles.kjv: When thou comest into thy neighbour’s vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.
controles.livre: Quando entrares na vinha de teu próximo, comerás uvas até saciar teu desejo: mas não porás em teu vaso.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י תָבֹא֙ בְּקָמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֔ךָ וְקָטַפְתָּ֥ מְלִילֹ֖ת בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְחֶרְמֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָנִ֔יף עַ֖ל קָמַ֥ת רֵעֶֽךָ׃ס

controles.web: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not move a sickle to your neighbor’s standing grain.
controles.kjv: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour’s standing corn.
controles.livre: Quando entrares na plantação de teu próximo, poderás cortar espigas com tua mão; mas não aplicarás foice à plantação de teu próximo.
